title: The Fault in Our Stars
author: John Green
summary: Hazel, a sixteen-year-old living with cancer, meets Augustus at a support group. They bond over a favourite novel and a trip they hope will answer the questions it leaves open.
readIf: you want a witty, tearful teen romance that treats illness without pity.
skipIf: you want to avoid stories about young people with terminal illness.

pairings.reason: Another love story shaped by illness and hard choices, aimed at older readers.
A young adult story about love and time running out, with a high concept.
Another John Green novel about first love and loss, with a different structure.
